config.text:
CONCEPT BRIEF — edit before running.
Character concept: tea-ceremony master in exile, pre-industrial, rendered as stop-motion puppet
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 4 panels, identical character across all of them.
tea-ceremony master in exile, pre-industrial, rendered as stop-motion puppet concept art moodboard, a punchy saturated candy palette, honed travertine
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'tea-ceremony master in exile, pre-industrial, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Lighting reference: a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'tea-ceremony master in exile, pre-industrial, rendered as stop-motion puppet'.

PANEL. This branch renders the back view: rear orthographic showing back construction and rigging.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even a ring light on axis for flat, modern, shadowless coverage, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — corrugated metal, draped silk and others — with their wear state, and grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
